title: plugintypestatistic
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, plugintypeid.

averageexecutetimeinmilliseconds.description: The average execution time (in milliseconds) for the plug-in type.

crashcontributionpercent.description: The plug-in type percentage contribution to crashes.

crashcount.description: Number of times the plug-in type has crashed.

crashpercent.description: Percentage of crashes for the plug-in type.

createdon.description: Date and time when the plug-in type statistic was created.

executecount.description: Number of times the plug-in type has been executed.

failurecount.description: Number of times the plug-in type has failed.

failurepercent.description: Percentage of failures for the plug-in type.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the plug-in type statistic was last modified.

plugintypestatisticid.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in type statistic.

terminatecpucontributionpercent.description: The plug-in type percentage contribution to Worker process termination due to excessive CPU usage.

terminatehandlescontributionpercent.description: The plug-in type percentage contribution to Worker process termination due to excessive handle usage.

terminatememorycontributionpercent.description: The plug-in type percentage contribution to Worker process termination due to excessive memory usage.

terminateothercontributionpercent.description: The plug-in type percentage contribution to Worker process termination due to unknown reasons.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the plug-in type statistic.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the plug-in type statistic.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the plug-in type statistic.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the plug-in type statistic.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization with which the plug-in type statistic is associated.

_plugintypeid_value.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in type associated with this plug-in type statistic.
